Panentheism.fact: Panentheism ( ; "all in God", from the Greek πᾶν, pân, 'all', ἐν, en, 'in' and Θεός, Theós, 'God') is the belief that the divine intersects every part of the universe and also extends beyond space and time. Philadelphia transit strike of 1944.question: In response to PTC's hiring of 100 new white motormen in early 1943, the _____ urged the company to consider Black applicants, but PTC again cited the customs clause as grounds for refusal
Philadelphia transit strike of 1944.fact: In response to PTC's hiring of 100 new white motormen in early 1943, the War Manpower Commission urged the company to consider Black applicants, but PTC again cited the customs clause as grounds for refusal. With labor shortages growing critical, national attention on racial discrimination in wartime industries intensified, and the FEPC, bolstered by a partnership with the War Manpower Commission, began to push harder against PTC's discriminatory policies.
